map.橡胶材料自检：按断裂强力、断裂伸长率、磨耗量三项判定: Rubber material self-check: judge by breaking force, elongation and abrasion loss
map.耐磨评估：磨耗量直接关系使用寿命: Wear assessment: abrasion loss directly relates to service life
map.报告可用性：三项全合格方可用于品质验收: Report usability: only all three pass may it be used for quality acceptance
map.逐项判定：断裂强力≥15MPa、断裂伸长率≥200%、磨耗量≤0.1g；三项均满: Item-by-item: breaking force ≥15 MPa, elongation ≥200%, abrasion ≤0.1 g; all pass → qualified. Force and elongation reflect elasticity and toughness; smaller abrasion means more wear-resistant.
map.强力 18MPa（≥15 ✓）、伸长率 250%（≥200 ✓）、磨耗 0.06: Force 18 MPa (≥15 ✓), elongation 250% (≥200 ✓), abrasion 0.06 g (≤0.1 ✓): all pass → qualified. If abrasion rises to 0.15 g it fails, signalling poor wear resistance and shorter life.
map.伸长率大是好还是坏？: Is high elongation good or bad?
map.对橡胶制品，适当高伸长率代表弹性好、抗撕裂；但过高且强力不足会偏软，须结合强力综: For rubber, suitably high elongation means good elasticity and tear resistance; but too high with low force gets too soft, so read with force and pass all three together.
map.通常按阿克隆/邓禄普磨耗机在一定行程下称量失重（g）；本工具以 ≤0.1g 为合: Usually by an Akron/Dunlop abrader weighing mass loss (g) over a set travel; this tool uses ≤0.1 g as the pass cap, adjusted per product standard.
map.拉伸试验需控制拉伸速度，样品应按标准裁制: Tensile testing needs controlled speed and standard specimen cutting
